rule1.title: 📜 | Rule 1 - Stay Safe!
content: Don't share personal or sensitive information with anyone [...] **You shall not share other peoples sensitive information, regardless of consent.**
Additionally, **You will not discuss or debate sensitive topics such as religions or politics.** [...]
We also require **ALL MESSAGES TO BE IN ENGLISH.**
A breach could result in punishment for your safety and that of the server.

1.title: 📖 🌍 | RULE 1.01. - "__ENGLISH OR AMERICAN.__"
content: **It is discouraged for members of the Scratch Community to send messages in other language.**
**Examples include:**

Long messages in a foreign language, regardless of if whomever present understands it or not. 
[...]
🌐 | If you seek other language servers, do check out the regional scratch servers available.

rule2.title: 📜 | Rule 2 - Be Respectful!
content: Do not be disruptive to other people. [...] Do not engage in chaotic behaviour such as spamming, ghost-pinging, or building walls of text.
At absolutely no point will we tolerate bigotry, discrimination, nor bullying in our Scratch Community.
You are obligated to respect the consent of members; should they tell you to stop doing something within reason, stop.
If you do not respect peoples boundaries, you will not be tolerated.

1.title: 📖 🫵 | RULE 2.01. - "CRAP CRITIQUE."
content: **It is forbidden for members of the Scratch Community to react negatively to the showcase posts others have made.** [...]

You ultimately have the right to provide critique on a person's artwork (which, ideally, you should ask for consent beforehand), but make sure you do so in a way that enables the person to build upon and patch their mistakes. All art has mistakes, please don't just highlight them without offering a solution.

2.title: 📖 🖌️ | RULE 2.02. - "NEGATIVE PAINTING."
content: **It is forbidden for members of the Scratch Community to use this place as a tool** [...] **to portray another being in a negative light.** It does not matter whether the person in question is present or not.
This applies to Scratch Servers too, please do not rant about the moderators of Turbowarp in our https://discord.com/channels/1140996822131802192/1140996823364943933 [...]
[...] it is forbidden to badmouth members of the team directly. You can criticise the Scratch Team as a whole - just please do not let a name become overly targeted. [...]

3.title: 📖 👥 | RULE 2.03. - "CREATE CLONE OF USER."
content: **It is forbidden for members of the Scratch Community to impersonate, pretend, or mimic another user regardless of consent.** This applies to profile picture or username changes to match another person.

rule3.title: 📜 | Rule 3 - Safe For Everyone (SFE)!
content: We will not tolerate [...] NSFW material here. You will be punished for breaching this rule - all content, messages, etc, MUST be 13+ appropriate.
-# In the context of showcases, any gore or other possibly upsetting material should be spoilered.
If your message can be interpreted sexually, it will be interpreted sexually, and you will be punished accordingly.

1.title: 📖 💕 | RULE 3.01. - "FANTASIES."
content: It is forbidden for any member of the Scratch Community to post - be it gif, text, video, or audio - content that is typically sexual in nature.
This rule also includes images that include the "boykissers" or "femboy" archetypes.

2.title: 📖 🩸 | RULE 3.02. - "GORE AND GUTS."
content: -# (⚠️) This rule does NOT apply to casual gore material which are entirely, completely prohibited.
-# (⚠️) This rule does NOT apply to sexual violence material which is entirely, completely prohibited.

It is forbidden for any member of the Scratch Community to post artwork of a graphic nature in https://discord.com/channels/1140996822131802192/1140996823364943935 without spoilers, and ideally a descriptive content warning (But a simple 'TW - BLOOD' would suffice).
[...] If you think you may need a Trigger Warning (TW) or Caution Warning (CW), it is best to play it safe and include those in your post, alongside spoiling the artwork. [...]
